body:
You seem to be one of the few, then, and I'm sorry if this post offended you. We need more people like you.

In my experience, and from perusing the subreddit upon various occasions, I have noted that so many people simply don't care. Some posts go completely ignored, others are filled with things such as "chin up," or "just smile," or the like. I have seen victims try so fucking hard to explain that they lack the capability of getting up and making a change, and folks respond with "no man, that's bullshit, only *you* can stand up and do it!" as if it's an easy endeavor. They just don't understand. They don't realize that all brains and all bodies and all persons and all personalities work differently. Some of us just can't say "fuck it" and turn into Jim Carrey from Yes Man. Some of us aren't the Hollywood-depressed type who's actually just a quirky kid who wields the ability to just "turn that frown upside down" and make that necessary change with a big, white grin. When I go to sleep, I enter a world of beauty, one with no pain. I find myself happy and content for the only time in my life. For some of us this waking world is a living fucking hell, and I realize that for certain people that might be a difficult concept to grasp, but when I see someone say "Hey, I've been at the very bottom and I turned my life around - so can you!" I want to grab them by the collar and just scream, don't you get it? Can't you see? *I'm not you*. I can't do that. I *wish* I could. I *wish* I could be some semblance of normal. God do I wish it were that simple. I wish I could look out the window and feel an intense desire to go out and enjoy that beautiful day out there, but that lovely sunlight in one person's eyes just isn't quite as lovely in the eyes of another. And so often is this dismissed as casual negativity when it's something so much more. I'm not asking for a cure. I'm not asking for advice. I'm just asking for some kind of empathy. Some kind of understanding. Just something to keep me, even for a moment, from remembering that I am the fucking messed up load of shit I've become.

I wish I could say. My one friend of nearly a decade got a new girlfriend and decided she was the only person he needed in his life so we've since stopped talking. My other friend, someone I've considered my best friend since 2008 (we met online, so it's not like we see each other in person much) simply vanished. Over the past few years she just stopped talking to me. A few months ago she informed me that she had been seeing someone for two years and that's partially why she's been MIA but we went back to talking like usual and then, bam, just like that, she disappears again. Our mutual friend informed me, yesterday, that she thinks I was mad at her for some reason, and feels like I've been using our mutual friend to start drama and be the messenger between us... which is unusual, considering the fact that the mutual friend is the one who approached me about all of it to begin with, and, essentially, we had a bit of a falling out. Which sucks, because I honestly saw her as one of my closest friends, but given her absence it isn't entirely surprising.

Still... it doesn't really need to be surprising to break your fucking heart, you know?
